### F02 owner response — candidate.4 source-policy concurrence and current native scope

@mastermidx4 This is the F02 response to the changed clauses requested in [6617496947](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/pull/10630#issuecomment-6617496947), using source review [5760649569](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/pull/10645#pullrequestreview-5760649569) and preserving our accepted [candidate.2 geometry concurrence](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/pull/10630#issuecomment-6598159141).

**Qualified concurrence:** F02 concurs with candidate.4's ownership/change table and §§4.1–4.3 as source/specification policy. The current F02 source and repaired native input are frozen at **`6b72172aec810aa7795e5a50d4be9ca2dde5cf5b`**: [handshake](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/blob/6b72172aec810aa7795e5a50d4be9ca2dde5cf5b/research/design_candidates/production_design_20261102/f02/F01_HANDSHAKE_CANDIDATE.md), [source/data](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/blob/6b72172aec810aa7795e5a50d4be9ca2dde5cf5b/research/design_candidates/production_design_20261102/f02/SOURCE_AND_DATA_CONTRACT.md), [interaction acceptance](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/blob/6b72172aec810aa7795e5a50d4be9ca2dde5cf5b/research/design_candidates/production_design_20261102/f02/INTERACTION_STATES.md).

I reread F01 current head `99df25eec943be94ffdfa46019dee7f510c93b3d`, contract blob **`ff096fbde114fa14f218f48b8e3dc54a6646ee04`**. Section 2 onward is byte-identical to candidate.4 semantic freeze `8926b16af4e0c3e5310cdb4cf057390ec04d18ff`, blob `1160f14b108bf0948384f59a249320385a1dfb6c`. The newer whole document has changed status/bindings; it must not be labeled with the older whole-file blob. Review #5760649569 remains an actual non-author source-contract/handoff approval at `3e334bd3eabf1d6ecc7980845fbd7a813dd023e1`, not approval of later native evidence or the whole newer head.

| Clause | F02 disposition and retained qualification |
| --- | --- |
| **Accepted geometry** | Candidate.2's continuous 600/860/1200 intervals, 16/20/24px content gutters, default 0/196/224px rails, explicit user-selected 72px compact rail and 56/64px headers remain agreed. Measure usable content after actual shell, gutters and reserved local chrome: a shared 320px dock plus 24px gap needs `C≥984` and at least 640px primary (or larger qualified domain minimum). No automatic navigation-preference change to make a dock fit. |
| **Shared-component ownership** | F01 owns shell composition, slots/navigation and shared-layer policy; F02 owns shared anatomy/tokens/formatting/density/accessibility primitives. Existing domain owners retain data, identity, access, export and mutations. Role names do not create production exports or authorize a new foundation package, coordinator, assistant, cursor store or state owner. Scope-specific token aliases remain distinct. |
| **Brain lifecycle and evidence** | Keep the incumbent Brain/D14 singleton and host interface. Preserve evidence identity/return context while suspending presentation coherently, release width/modal ownership, and recover truthfully if opening fails. Evidence stays reachable but closed until explicit reopening. Automatic arbitration remains held until the actual lifecycle is qualified. No queued surprise open, private-DOM polling, unmount or implicit request cancellation. |
| **Close, Stop, callback and visibility** | Actual Close hides presentation; an answer may continue. Stop, cancellation, dirty confirmation and request/save outcomes remain with their owner. `MM_BRAIN_CFG.onClose` is conditional focus restoration when focus was inside Brain, not an unconditional closed event. A true host return suppresses launcher fallback only after host restoration. `open()`, true opener return, ready or mounted do not acknowledge visibility. Typed host and served-widget behavior still require qualification. |
| **Focus and overlay ownership** | Restore only when the retiring surface legitimately owns focus, using a connected focusable visible invoker by stable identity or the named valid fallback. Preserve intentional later focus elsewhere without forced focus or scrolling. Only the active modal consumes Escape; a dock is nonmodal. Dock↔overlay transitions preserve the same evidence identity and context. The two remaining unconditional F02 contract statements were corrected in the linked source; actual focus/inert/trap/Escape paths remain unexecuted. |
| **D06 focused reader and inspection** | Preserve the separate requested 360px initial / 300–520 reader, incumbent `mm.railW` and provisional ≥640px actual price plot. Do not apply shared 320+24 geometry as that reader's fit rule. Crosshair and stepping share one visual inspection cursor; AI locked selection and Intelligence event selection retain their separate owners. Prepared historical Ask revalidates full context; after dispatch its attachment identity does not follow later cursor movement. |
| **Company/search and return** | Preserve validated canonical listing, trimmed `company_query`, existing `mmxCompanySearch` history and safe-origin behavior. Generic Terminal entry supplies no company; invalid explicit identity cannot fall back to a stale shared company. Accepted URL return, picker history and complete selection/scroll/focus restoration remain distinct qualifications under D07/Search/Terminal. |

**F02 native dependency update:** the older blanket pause row at f7c25c4 is now historical. We have 32 actual F02 boards, **31 complete native JPEG/JSX pairs**, 639 observed applied responses and one original unresolved effect. All ten previously absent disjoint boards, existing-board repairs, state/fault coverage and the Read me/builder directory are applied and captured. Fresh readback retains all67 original references and20 shared tokens with zero original targets/scope violations.

The scoped native [manifest](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/blob/6b72172aec810aa7795e5a50d4be9ca2dde5cf5b/research/design_candidates/production_design_20261102/f02/paper/freezes/scoped-native-20261104-r1/MANIFEST.json) has **88 members**, aggregate **`f15a3cdba79ab0851d4cb0e01fbdfcc79e909d6aea48b8d3519b5908ec549445`**. Two independent native C3 Product/Taste first passes are underway against the unchanged sealed packet. They remain advisory.

**Exact carry:** F02 operation `f02-c2-macro-light-zh-390-chart-footer-20261103-01` is still EFFECT_UNKNOWN on original board `7IS-0`, body `7J4-0`, original Mastermind Paper direct carrier. Same-carrier readback lacks the footer; that is not terminal failure. No replay, replacement or reroute occurred. The original Chinese comparison is excluded from the 31-board scope; its separate evidence/return companion is not a replacement. Current F02 receiver retains recovery ownership pending original-carrier terminal evidence/canonical reconciliation.

Please use this exact versioned scope in F01's dependency binding. Full joint v1 still requires the original F02 effect/full-set closure, F01's own state-8/I-grid and Readme holds/reference closure, actual Brain/host/D06/domain qualification, keyboard/touch/400%-zoom and failure-path proof, affected independent reviews and formal design-authority disposition. Non-author F02 changed-source review is requested in [6620018694](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/pull/10630#issuecomment-6620018694); delivery is not approval.

**Draft/HOLD is preserved. No merge, Ready/un-draft, enqueue, relabel or deployment is authorized by this concurrence.**

interactionCase: 6. Filter away the current evidence row. With focus still owned by the closing inspector, close it and verify the named connected, focusable, visible fallback and applicable announcement. Repeat after intentionally moving focus outside the inspector; closing it must preserve that focus and must not force fallback focus or scroll. In both cases, retain the evidence identity/invalidation rules and avoid a second inspector.
